title: The Fourth Man in the Fire

pages.caption: Three men trust God, and the king sees a fourth man walking with them in the fire.
King Nebuchadnezzar makes a huge golden statue and gathers his leaders.
Everyone is ordered to bow to the statue when the music plays.
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego stay standing and do not worship the statue.
The three men are brought before the angry king.
They say God can rescue them, but even if he does not, they will not worship the statue.
The king orders a hotter furnace, and soldiers tie up the three men.
The fire kills the soldiers who take them up, and the three men fall into the furnace.
The king sees four men walking in the fire, untied and not hurt.
The king calls, and Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego come out.
The men are unharmed. Their hair and coats are not burned, and they do not smell of fire.
The king praises their God and makes a new rule.
The king gives the three men more important jobs in Babylon. They trusted God, and he rescued them.
